data.name: Update a Record
data.description:
Update a record's data.
User Interface API enforces Salesforce validation rules. If a validation rule fails, the response is an Error with Output.
When you make a PATCH request to update a record, make sure that the record hasn’t changed since the user started editing it. To find out whether it’s safe to save a record, pass the If-Modified-Since HTTP header in the request.
As of API version 43.0, if you pass read-only fields in a request body, the response is an Error with Output.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing Salesforce record through the User Interface API, enforcing Salesforce validation rules. Use it to save changes to a record while respecting editable fields and concurrency checks.
Use for: edit a Salesforce record, change record fields, save validated updates, update with freshness checking
Not supported: creating records, deleting records, querying records

data.name: Update a contact
data.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by {contactId}. {contactId} refers to the internal object ID. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.
data.evaluateGuide:
Partially updates a HubSpot CRM contact identified by its internal object ID. Supplied property values overwrite existing values, while empty strings clear them.
Use for: edit contact properties, clear contact values, update a CRM contact, sync contact changes
Not supported: creating contacts, deleting contacts, listing contacts
